title: Deer eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- deer body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='15' ry='7' fill='#f2dcc0'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='40' y='42' width='12' height='20' rx='5' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='44' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#e8b98a'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='#7a4a2a'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='37' r='1.8' fill='#3a2414'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='34' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#c98a4b' transform='rotate(20 48 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='34' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#f2dcc0' transform='rotate(20 48 34)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M44 31 L42 22 M42 22 L38 18 M42 22 L46 17' stroke='#a86a32' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48 30 L50 21 M50 21 L54 17 M50 21 L47 16' stroke='#a86a32' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='72' width='4' height='16' rx='2' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <rect x='44' y='73' width='4' height='15' rx='2' fill='#b07538'/>
  <rect x='56' y='73' width='4' height='15' rx='2' fill='#b07538'/>
  <rect x='62' y='72' width='4' height='16' rx='2' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='58' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#f2dcc0'/>
  <!-- apple snack on the ground -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='84' r='6' fill='#e0402f'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='82' r='1.5' fill='#ff8a70'/>
  <path d='M28 78 L29 74' stroke='#6b9a3a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='74' rx='3' ry='1.5' fill='#7ec24a' transform='rotate(-25 31 74)'/>
  <!-- bite/grazing arc: little crumbs -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='83' r='0.8' fill='#e0402f'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='85' r='0.8' fill='#e0402f'/>
</svg>
